purpose: New painted surfaces for the authored Sparks loft assets. Runtime textures are embedded through the normal world GLB build.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a NEW production surface illustration for real 3D furniture in a cozy outlined storybook game. Input 1 is a STYLE AND COLOUR reference only, not an edit target. Match its painterly brushwork, restrained warm-brown linework and soft broad colour areas. The illustration fills the entire canvas edge to edge. Orthographic FLAT surface view, no perspective, no 3D object, no scene, no drop shadow, no text, watermark or border. Opaque PNG, 1536x1024.
Primary request: one seamless honey-oak wood grain material. Calm light warm honey-brown wood, pale brushed ridges, sparse thin hand-inked grain curls and tiny worn marks. Grain runs horizontally from left to right. Broad soft tones and little contrast, as the loft floor and desk in the reference; no dark cracks, no separate planks, no repeating checkerboard or brick arrangement. Quiet painted wood rather than photographic wood.
images.tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; model identifier not exposed

images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a NEW painted landscape used as the view THROUGH the loft windows and on a little wall postcard in a storybook game. Input 1 supplies the town identity and painted warm outlines. A quiet morning hillside harbour: close terracotta and green-copper rooftops with cream plaster chimneys in the lower quarter, a turquoise sea cove and small sailboats in the middle, distant cream/ochre/salmon houses on a green hill and a tiny lighthouse, pale blue morning sky across the top third. Flat landscape illustration, no window frame, no room, no UI, no people, no lettering, no watermark. Pale-gold daylight, calm sea, no orange emission or night glow. Landscape opaque PNG 1536x1024.
